answer: No assertion strings named. Derivable from code (operations.py:41,50; runtime.py:34-59). But atoms list on a fresh sandbox prints nothing (atoms.py:158-169), so its 'stable line' needs a seeded atom or --format json. Fix: name the asserted line per subcommand, or allow exit-code-only when output is empty.

--root is per-subcommand, not global: build_parser adds no top-level --root (parser.py:24-58); each subparser adds its own (parser.py:68,73,76,89,138,154). Pass it after the subcommand, e.g. main(['atoms','list','--root',str(root)]).

_cli (tests/test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:22) is subprocess-only, unusable in-process; _make_repo (:36) is module-level but tests/ has no __init__.py or conftest.py, so cross-module import is unreliable. Fix: copy the ~10-line repo builder into tests/test_cli_contract.py.

supervise takes --max-iterations (parser.py:92) and --timeout-ms (parser.py:104), documented 'mainly for testing' (parser.py:94). With a stubbed HerdrClient (runner=), call main(['runtime','supervise','agent','--root',root,'--max-iterations','1']); it returns 1 on timeout/unknown (runtime.py:91).
parametrize produces one test case per subcommand, so it satisfies Done When's 'each subcommand has its own test'; the two statements are compatible.
Rationale enumerates 4 single subcommands plus 5 runtime ones (init, status, attach, stop, supervise); Done When fixes the total at 9, matching.
Scope already says surprises are discovered at execution and recorded as drawer tasks with strict xfail; no advance list is required.

Deferred drawer tasks are desk/drawer/tasks/task-<slug>.md with frontmatter id/status/references/depends_on/pills/files/task_type/tags (e.g. task-rw-f0-closeout-commit-pathspec.md:1-17), listed under Tasks on desk/drawer/tasks/Board.md; recording them is in scope, fixing is not.

Resolved Decisions' 'executor does not commit' is explicit and overrides AGENTS.md's author-side drawer-commit rule, so new drawer files stay untracked for the supervisor. Fix: state this, and have the supervisor pass their paths to closeout commit (which needs --paths or staged files, closeout.py:66-72).
Success lines are print()ed to stdout (operations.py:41,50,57; atoms.py:167); main()'s error branches print to stderr (main.py:377-390). Assert the success line in capsys.readouterr().out.
